title: whisper-tiny vs whisper-base in a browser tab: word error rate, timing, transfer size and peak memory
description: Measurements of two quantised Whisper tiers (onnx-community/whisper-tiny and onnx-community/whisper-base) running client-side in a real Chrome window. Word error rate on eight clips across five acoustic conditions (229 reference words), wall-clock timing on byte-identical audio from 13 to 1610 seconds, per-file transfer size of the model as served, peak resident memory of the browser process tree, browser decodability of eight container formats, and a single-clip Mandarin character error rate at three normalization levels. The measurements were taken on clipquill.com, a page that runs the model in the visitor's own tab.
notes: Measurement machine: 2-core AMD EPYC 9754, 3.94 GB RAM, shared CPU. Two speakers only, one noise type. See METHOD.md for the full list of what is not covered.
